label: Parenica
note: Slovak PGI; wound into two spiral rolls joined in an S, usually smoked.

about.text: Parenica is a semi-firm, non-ripening, steamed and usually smoked Slovak cheese, wound from strips into snail-like spirals. In the 1800s it was made from pure raw sheep milk; modern versions also use cow milk or mixtures.

facts.v: Valaška, Zošľachtená valaška or Cigája sheep; or sheep plus cow, with sheep at least 50 % (Slow Food)
Two rolls 6–8 cm across, 5–8 cm high, joined by a ribbon in an S
